mapper.select: SELECT t1.CORP_GR , TO_CHAR(t1.TR_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS tr_ymd , t1.TR_CD , t1.FUND_CD , t1.TRUSTEE , t1.JM_CD AS hj_cd , t1.TR_SEQ , t1.AEK_GB , t1.CURRENCY , t1.TR_CO_CD , t1.AEK , t1.JAN_AEK , t1.WON_AEK , t1.WON_JAN_AEK , TO_CHAR(t1.SANGHW_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS sanghw_ymd , TO_CHAR(t1.BF_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS bf_ymd , TO_CHAR(t1.AF_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS af_ymd , t1.BIGO , t1.GWAMOK , F_FUND_NM(t1.CORP_GR, t1.FUND_CD) AS xx_fund_cd , F_JM_NM(t1.CORP_GR, t1.JM_CD) AS xx_jm_nm , t2.GIJUN_RT , t2.WON_SANGHW_AEK , 1 AS p_visible , TO_CHAR(t1.TR_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS orig_tr_ymd , t1.TR_CD AS orig_tr_cd , t1.FUND_CD AS orig_fund_cd , t1.JM_CD AS orig_hj_cd , t1.TR_SEQ AS orig_tr_seq , t1.AEK_GB AS orig_aek_gb FROM SYT9MG t1 LEFT JOIN SYT9MG_TR t2 ON t2.CORP_GR = t1.CORP_GR AND t2.TR_YMD = t1.TR_YMD AND t2.TR_CD = t1.TR_CD AND t2.FUND_CD = t1.FUND_CD AND t2.JM_CD = t1.JM_CD AND t2.TR_SEQ = t1.TR_SEQ AND t2.AEK_GB = t1.AEK_GB AND t2.SANGHW_YMD = TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') WHERE t1.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND COALESCE(t1.SANGHW_YMD, TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD')) >= TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') ORDER BY t1.TR_YMD ASC , t1.FUND_CD ASC , t1.JM_CD ASC , t1.TR_SEQ ASC

SELECT t1.CORP_GR , TO_CHAR(t1.TR_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS tr_ymd , t1.TR_CD , t1.FUND_CD , t1.TRUSTEE , t1.JM_CD AS hj_cd , t1.TR_SEQ , t1.AEK_GB , t1.CURRENCY , t1.TR_CO_CD , t1.SANGHW_AEK , t1.WON_SANGHW_AEK , t1.GIJUN_RT , t1.JAN_AEK , t1.WON_JAN_AEK , t1.WON_HWAN_CHA , t1.FCUR_JAN_AEK , t1.FCUR_HWAN_CHA , TO_CHAR(t1.SANGHW_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS sanghw_ymd , TO_CHAR(t1.SANGHW_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS orig_sanghw_ymd , F_FUND_NM(t1.CORP_GR, t1.FUND_CD) AS xx_fund_cd , F_JM_NM(t1.CORP_GR, t1.JM_CD) AS xx_jm_nm , 1 AS p_visible FROM SYT9MG_TR t1 WHERE t1.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND t1.TR_YMD = TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{trYmd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') AND t1.TR_CD = #{trCd} AND t1.FUND_CD = #{fundCd} AND t1.JM_CD = #{hjCd} AND t1.TR_SEQ = #{trSeq} AND t1.AEK_GB = #{aekGb} ORDER BY t1.SANGHW_YMD ASC
SELECT DISTINCT TO_CHAR(t1.TR_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS ymd FROM SYT9MG t1 WHERE t1.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} ORDER BY ymd
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SYT9MG ( CORP_GR , TR_YMD , TR_CD , FUND_CD , TRUSTEE , JM_CD , TR_SEQ , AEK_GB , CURRENCY , TR_CO_CD , AEK , JAN_AEK , WON_AEK , WON_JAN_AEK , SANGHW_YMD , BF_YMD , AF_YMD , BIGO , GWAMOK ) VALUES ( #{corpGr, jdbcType=VARCHAR} , TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{trYmd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') , #{trCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} , #{fundCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} , #{trustee, jdbcType=VARCHAR} , #{hjCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} , COALESCE(#{trSeq, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, 1) , COALESCE(#{aekGb, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '1') , #{currency, jdbcType=VARCHAR} , #{trCoCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} , COALESCE(#{aek, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, 0) , COALESCE(#{janAek, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, 0) , COALESCE(#{wonAek, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, 0) , COALESCE(#{wonJanAek, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, 0) , CASE WHEN #{sanghwYmd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NOT NULL AND #{sanghwYmd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} != '' THEN TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{sanghwYmd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') ELSE NULL END , CASE WHEN #{bfYmd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NOT NULL AND #{bfYmd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} != '' THEN TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{bfYmd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') ELSE NULL END , CASE WHEN #{afYmd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NOT NULL AND #{afYmd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} != '' THEN TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{afYmd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') ELSE NULL END , #{bigo, jdbcType=VARCHAR} , #{gwamok, jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM SYT9MG WHERE CORP_GR = #{corpGr, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND TR_YMD = TO_DATE(REPLACE(COALESCE(#{origTrYmd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{trYmd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}), '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') AND TR_CD = COALESCE(#{origTrCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{trCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AND FUND_CD = COALESCE(#{origFundCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{fundCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AND JM_CD = COALESCE(#{origHjCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{hjCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AND TR_SEQ = COALESCE(#{origTrSeq, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{trSeq, jdbcType=NUMERIC}) AND AEK_GB = COALESCE(#{origAekGb, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{aekGb, jdbcType=VARCHAR})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SYT9MG_TR ( CORP_GR , TR_YMD , TR_CD , FUND_CD , TRUSTEE , JM_CD , TR_SEQ , AEK_GB , CURRENCY , TR_CO_CD , SANGHW_AEK , WON_SANGHW_AEK , GIJUN_RT , JAN_AEK , WON_JAN_AEK , WON_HWAN_CHA , FCUR_JAN_AEK , FCUR_HWAN_CHA , SANGHW_YMD ) VALUES ( #{corpGr, jdbcType=VARCHAR} , TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{trYmd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') , #{trCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} , #{fundCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} , #{trustee, jdbcType=VARCHAR} , #{hjCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} , COALESCE(#{trSeq, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, 1) , COALESCE(#{aekGb, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '1') , #{currency, jdbcType=VARCHAR} , #{trCoCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} , COALESCE(#{sanghwAek, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, 0) , COALESCE(#{wonSanghwAek, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, 0) , COALESCE(#{gijunRt, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, 0) , COALESCE(#{janAek, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, 0) , COALESCE(#{wonJanAek, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, 0) , COALESCE(#{wonHwanCha, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, 0) , COALESCE(#{fcurJanAek, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, 0) , COALESCE(#{fcurHwanCha, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, 0) , TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{sanghwYmd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') )
